settings.name_in_paper: sparse stochastic linear contextual bandit (LCB) with high-dimensional contexts
unmapped: The set of N context vectors {b_1(t),...,b_N(t)} is drawn i.i.d. over t from a joint distribution P_b; contexts of different arms may be correlated within a round
Compatibility condition on the covariance of the averaged context E[bar b bar b^T] with constant phi_1 (Assumption A3)
Learner (theoretical tuning of z_T) uses the compatibility constant phi_1
settings.definition_quote: We specifically consider a sparse LCB problem, where $\theta_t(b_i(t))$ is linear in $b_i(t)$, $\theta_t(b_i(t))=b_i(t)^T\beta$, where $\beta\in\mathbb{R}^d$ is unknown and $||\beta||_0=s_0(\ll d)$ ... A1 Bounded norms: $||b_i(t)||_2\leq 1, ||\beta||_2\leq 1$. A2 IID Context Assumption ... A3 Compatibility Assumption ... A4 Sub-Gaussian error.

symbols.phi_1: compatibility constant of E[bar b(t) bar b(t)^T] (Assumption A3)
symbols.R_tilde: sub-Gaussian parameter of the doubly-robust pseudo-reward, claimed O(1)
symbols.lambda_1: exploration tuning parameter of the algorithm

conditions: noise R-sub-Gaussian with 0 < R < O((log T / T)^(1/4)) (A4)
tuning: z_T = max(3 log d / C_phi^2, log(T^2/delta')/C_phi^2)
lambda_{1t} = lambda_1 sqrt((log t + log d)/t)
lambda_{2t} = lambda_2 sqrt((log t + log d)/t)

source.label: thm1
source.quote: Suppose (\ref{linear}) and assumptions \ref{bddness}, \ref{iid}, \ref{compatibility}, and \ref{subgauss} hold. Then we have for $\forall\delta\in (0,\frac{1}{2})$ and $\forall \delta'\in (0,\delta)$, with probability at least $1-2\delta$, R(T) \leq \mathrm{max}(...)+\frac{\sqrt{128}}{\phi_1^2}s_0\tilde{R}\sqrt{T}\mathrm{log}(\frac{\mathrm{e}dT^2}{\delta-\delta'})+\lambda_1\sqrt{T}\mathrm{log}(dT)+\sqrt{\frac{T}{2}\mathrm{log}(\frac{1}{\delta})} = O(s_0\sqrt{T}\mathrm{log}(dT))

results.notes: Holds with probability at least 1-2delta. Paper's N (number of arms) is K; bound independent of K. Regret is conditional-mean regret against per-round best arm. R_tilde is asserted O(1) informally. Instance-independent in gaps but depends on compatibility constant phi_1.

conditions: noise R-sub-Gaussian with 0 < R < O((log T / T)^(1/4)) (A4)
tuning: z_T = max(3 log d / C(phi_1)^2, log(T^2/delta')/C(phi_1)^2)
lambda_{1t} = lambda_1 sqrt((log t + log d)/t)
lambda_{2t} = lambda_2 sqrt((log t + log d)/t)
results.notes: Order form of Theorem 4.1; hides phi_1, delta and the z_T term (which scales as s_0^2 log(dT)/phi_1^4).
